sn56.46:1.1: atthi bhikkhave, lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārakā andhakāratimisā. yatthāpimesaṃ candimasuriyānaṃ evaṃmahiddhikānaṃ evaṃ mahānubhāvānaṃ ābhā nānubhontīti.
sn56.46:2.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn56.46:2.2: “mahā vata so bhante, andhakāro. sumahā vata so bhante, andhakāro.
sn56.46:2.3: atthi nukho bhante, etamhā andhakārā añño andhakāro mahantataro ca bhayānakataro cā”ti?
sn56.46:2.4: atthi kho bhikkhu, etamhā andhakārā añño andhakāro mahantataro ca bhayānakataro cāti.
sn56.46:3.1: katamo pana bhante, etamhā andhakārā añño andhakāro mahantataro ca bhayānakataro cāti?
sn56.46:3.2: ye hi keci bhikkhu, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā “idaṃ dukkha”nti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti.
sn56.46:3.3: te jātisaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti …pe… sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsasaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti. te jātisaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu
sn56.46:3.4: abhiratā …pe… sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsasaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiratā jātisaṃvattanikepi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharonti …pe… sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsasaṃvattanikepi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharonti. te jātisaṃvattanikepi saṅkhāre abhisaṅkharitvā …pe… sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsasaṃvattanikepi saṅkhāre
sn56.46:3.5: abhisaṅkharitvā jātandhakārampi papatanti, jarandhakārampi papatanti, maraṇandhakārampi papatanti, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsandhakārampi papatanti.
sn56.46:3.6: te na parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
sn56.46:4.1: ye ca kho keci bhikkhu, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā “idaṃ dukkha”nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti,
sn56.46:4.4: anabhisaṅkharitvā jātandhakārampi na papatanti. jarandhakārampi na papatanti, maraṇandhakārampi na papatanti. sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsandhakārampi na papatanti.
sn56.46:4.5: te parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi.
sn56.46:5.1: tasmātiha bhikkhu, “idaṃ dukkha”nti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
